the Fourier transform of SHG images of collagen fibers obtained from the forward (transmitted) and backward (reflected) direction of the laser beam produce overlapping peaks in the Fourier transform, indicating that some of the information present in the transmitted SHG images can potentially be extracted from the reflected SHG images, and that the magnitude of the peaks in the Fourier spectrum of the reflected images is dependent on the tissue type.
Fourier transforms of SHG images from forward and backward direction produce similar information on the preferred orientations of collagen fibers in three tissue types.
